verdict.rationale: Finix documents managing how sellers get paid out via the Dashboard or API, and says payout schedules can be set. It also offers real-time payouts to bank accounts or cards, card push payouts, and accelerated settlement timeframes. The evidence never spells out which cadences exist or that schedules are configurable individually per seller. Missing for 10: explicit daily/weekly/monthly/manual cadence options, documented per-seller schedule configuration, detail on which real-time rails are supported for seller payouts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
